name: map_tutorial_sneak_past
about: The tutorial's sneak-past lesson on thug_1 (docs/specs/0002-npc-ai/record-2026-09-30.md § Witness and § Witness data; docs/vtmb/sp_tutorial_1-event-surface.md). The map's trig_dialog_feed_on_rats fires thug_maker.Spawn; the record fires the same input. thug_1 (npc_VVampire, vision 540, hearing 1.00, investigate_mode 4, D_HT 5, use_interesting 1 / groups 2) takes pt1 (enabled 1, 30-60 s; pt2/pt3 enabled 0): 0xff -> 0x100 -> SCHED_TROIKA_DO_INTEREST_ACTIVITY. The player's footsteps behind him (180/240 units) are heard 0.2-0.9 s late as conditions only, never an enemy record; COND_INVESTIGATE_SOUND is on the interest programs' interrupt list (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_do_interest_activity.sch), so the program breaks and an INVESTIGATE program runs (turn, step, walk to the sound). Sight admits the player only inside 540 x the light scalar and the 157 deg cone with an eye-to-eye trace (0x10310710 PerformSensing); a pass writes SEE_PLAYER and the enemy record, NEW_ENEMY breaks the program, and the committed-enemy LOS edge in GatherEnemyConditions 0x10270b20 fires OnFoundPlayer (-> logic_failed_thug.Trigger 0.5 s).
known_red: 6: thug_1 (use_interesting 1) is owned by the port's ambient executor: no 0xff program, no gather
notes: Player places are map coordinates (cm) around pt1 (-1287.8, 213.4, -101.6) and thug_maker (-1287.8, 276.9): the footsteps start ~4.8 m behind him (+Y) and walk to ~1.4 m; the sight seat is 1.5 m in front along pt1's facing (Source yaw 101). They were chosen from the entity rows without a view of the geometry: an unwalkable seat is a record error to fix, not a red. The hearing half depends on the footstep sound producer (R1's CSound list) and may be red for that reason.
